facts.value: The Apprenticeships programme is designed for employers interested in developing the skills of their employees and driving the growth and development of their business.

metadata.chunk_title: For employers

facts.value: Employers who wish to employ apprentices are required to complete an approval process that includes registering their company's interest, completing the UL approval process, completing the SOLAS approval process, and completing the UL postgraduate registration process.

metadata.chunk_title: For employers

facts.value: Register your company's interest in the apprenticeship programme by completing the expression of interest form or by contacting us at apprenticeships@ul.ie.

metadata.chunk_title: For employers

facts.value: The UL Approval Process includes a site visit by a dedicated UL programme manager to assess suitability to host an apprenticeship and completing the Company sponsorship paperwork, including the identification of an In-Company Mentor.

metadata.chunk_title: For employers

facts.value: The SOLAS approval process includes a site visit by an Authorising Officer of the local Education & Training Board and SOLAS approval of the company for funding, including SOLAS paperwork for each apprentice.

metadata.chunk_title: For employers

facts.value: The UL Postgraduate Registration process involves UL Graduate & Professional Studies sending the successful applicant a link to proceed through the normal UL postgraduate student application process.

metadata.chunk_title: For employers
